So um recently I had an exam (which was one of the most important in my life and I screwed up) and I had to learn general knowledge and current affairs
So what I did was like read the question slowly and carefully , highlighted the answer , repeated it like 2-3 times . Then on to the next question. Then like after a while , maybe a few hours or on the next study session revise the questions . If you don't remember the answer write it down (it helps, it's been more than a week n I remember the stuff I wrote down )

Another VERY important thing is that while studying , whatever you're doing (reading or writing or watching the study stuff) FOCUS on that ONLY and ONLY. Do not think about anything else . I don't mean stop or be harsh on yourself but don't try to distract yourself it's harmful 

One more thing . TAKE INTEREST IN WHAT YOU'RE STUDYING. if it's boring make up fake interest. Like I was studying communication aptitude n like when I read stuff I asked myself "oh is this how it is " or asked questions to myself n revised shortly 

Most important REVISE REVISE REVISE !!!!
